استشرفا (form X)

# اُسْتُشْرِفَا (ustušrifā) /us.tuʃ.ri.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
# اِسْتَشْرِفَا (istašrifā) /is.taʃ.ri.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَشْرَفَ (istašrafa)
